gaps.explanation: No proprietary schedule; p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints Water, Sewer and Garbage Fund columns. Water 59,024 + 289 + 31,858 = 91,171; Sewer 60,014 + 362 - 4,018 = 56,358; Garbage 46,932 + 135 + 346 = 47,413; total 194,942 = statement 194,942.
